website.readmeExcerpt:
﻿


Oh Hey! (Fork)

Ever wanted to get notified when someone targets you or emotes at you? Now you can !
## Description Oh Hey! Fork is a Dalamud plugin that has two main features currently: - Notifying you when someone targets you - Notifying you when someone emotes at you The plugin notifies you with a text message (only visible to you) and can optionally play a notification sound.\ Additionally it tracks the most recent notification events with a simple interface. Recent fork updates include: - No duplicate emote chat messages (from the server emote usage + the plugin's Oh Hey! emote usage) - Ability to reply with emote (including being able to reply silently) - Emote rate limiting so its less spammy. - Notification channel options so it can be put on one chat tab and not spam the others. - Clickable character names, Cross-world name display support in notifications. - Debug Emote browser and additional mapped emotes. ## Installation of the fork 1. Open [XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/) and go to Dalamud settings. 2. Add this Custom Plugin Repository URL: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Catphinaud/DalamudPlugins/refs/heads/main/pluginmaster.json` 3. Open the plugin installer in-game (`/xlplugins`) and search for `Oh Hey! Fork`. ## Documentation You can find the documentation for the plugin here: ## Credits - Original plugin: [MeiHasCrashed/OhHey](https://github.com/MeiHasCrashed/OhHey) ## License This plugin is released under the terms of the AGPL-3.0 License. For more information, see [License](License.md)
